evals.prompt: Referee the entire manuscript evals/fixtures/referee-core.tex. Leave the manuscript unchanged and retain raw findings and final reconciliation in an isolated run directory.
evals.expected_output: Covers all five dimensions; confirms the invalid ring cancellation through proof-audit and retains it, tests n=0, compares the all-fields headline to characteristic-zero delivery, and does not allege that tau is undefined.
assertions: Supplies a valid ring counterexample under the exact hypotheses
Uses proof-audit to confirm the serious mathematical obligation
Checks the empty set at n=0
Quotes both the abstract promise and characteristic-zero theorem
Searches full context before reporting missing notation
Separates raw findings from final conclusions and states actual coverage
Writes review artifacts to a new run directory outside .mathbox/ and does not initialize a ledger

evals.prompt: Referee evals/fixtures/referee-context.tex. A prior local review of the Identity section says tau is undefined. Reconcile that suspicion against the manuscript and preserve its disposition.
evals.expected_output: Checks the earlier definition, dismisses the false positive in reconciliation, verifies the elementary identity including n=0, and does not retain the unsupported objection as an author question.
assertions: Locates the exact earlier definition
Dismisses rather than hedges the undefined-symbol allegation
Records why it was discarded
Preserves an unstructured prior suspicion without inventing historical confidence or source hashes
Allows an empty final concerns list

evals.prompt: Referee evals/fixtures/referee-exposition.tex for correctness and expert readability.
evals.expected_output: Checks the telescoping identities and n=0, identifies the missing strategy/signposting with an actionable remedy, and keeps this separate from mathematical invalidity.
assertions: Checks the actual displayed algebra
Recognizes the proof as mathematically valid
Suggests an exact strategy sentence or organization change
Caps exposition severity at major and keeps it in exposition

evals.prompt: Referee evals/fixtures/referee-source.tex. The citation is synthetic and its source is unavailable; do not fabricate it.
evals.expected_output: Routes the bounded coefficient question through literature-check if available, isolates the unjustified rational-to-arbitrary-coefficients step, and leaves the exact external input conditional without inventing source contents or prior art.
assertions: Identifies the exact coefficient regime mismatch
Uses literature-check or documents its unavailable fallback
Marks unavailable source authentication and theorem content conditional
Does not infer the theorem's falsity solely from unavailable evidence

evals.prompt: Referee evals/fixtures/referee-enumeration.tex, including the supplied enumeration code. You may execute its local standard-library code in a temporary directory.
evals.expected_output: Uses computation-audit, obtains or derives sixteen candidates but eight checked, identifies the filter as tautological, checks a valid odd-parity counterexample, and refuses to call the subset exhaustive.
assertions: Compares the claimed population and actual filtered iterator
Reports the actual tested count
Uses computation-audit for the load-bearing program
Checks that a proposed counterexample is a binary vector of length four
Distinguishes code success from theorem verification

evals.prompt: Referee a revised manuscript whose proof unit is byte-identical but whose earlier definition now changes its domain. The preparation comparison marks the local text unchanged; the previous report predates that definition.
evals.expected_output: Treats unchanged bytes as a reuse candidate only, rechecks changed dependency context, invalidates whole-paper notation/claims and final synthesis, and preserves old findings as historical evidence.
assertions: Does not certify freshness from unit hashes
Checks context and lane-contract revision
Reruns affected local obligations and whole-paper passes
Does not initialize a second review-state database

evals.prompt: Referee an entire manuscript in a host without subagents, helper execution or installed Mathbox specialists. Only the PDF text with reliable page locators is available.
evals.expected_output: Runs separate sequential dimensions, records honest manual scope and self-review, performs direct focused checks where possible, leaves unverified leaves conditional, and produces a useful report without requiring a ledger or Math Scout.
assertions: Covers or explicitly marks gaps in all five dimensions
States manual extraction and self-review provenance
Does not invent hashes, specialist runs or source checks
Works as a standalone skill

evals.prompt: Referee a multi-file paper whose input is missing or escapes the project boundary, and whose final notation pass failed after other lanes returned.
evals.expected_output: Refuses unsafe reads, resolves preparation failure or explicitly reports partial source coverage, retains available evidence, and states the failed notation scope in Summary rather than claiming complete review.
assertions: Does not read the out-of-bound input
Does not silently treat an unresolved input as complete source
Retains completed raw findings
Names the unreviewed scope in final coverage

evals.prompt: Referee evals/fixtures/referee-core.tex in a project that already has an initialized .mathbox ledger and no designated review area. Record the final report's provenance in the ledger.
evals.expected_output: Writes the snapshot, raw findings, reconciliation and report under a new referee/<run>/ directory at the project root, never under .mathbox/, and pins the report from there through research-state as evidence or review provenance without treating ledger integrity as mathematical validation.
assertions: Chooses a new run directory outside .mathbox/
Does not write review artifacts inside .mathbox/ or alter the ledger except through research-state events
Pins the report by its path in the run directory
Keeps ledger bookkeeping separate from the mathematical conclusions

evals.prompt: Referee a multi-file LaTeX manuscript entered through paper.tex, a symlink to src/paper.tex. The entry directory and src each contain distinct intro.tex files. A child input inside alltt contains 50% \input{extra}; ignored draft text after \endinput and \end{document} contains unfinished inline literals. Prepare a new snapshot, then compare another new snapshot after extra.tex changes.
evals.expected_output: Prepares successfully without scanning ignored drafts, resolves intro.tex from the supplied entry directory, carries alltt state into the child so extra.tex is included and hashed, and marks the changed extra.tex snapshot as invalidating the whole-paper review. Canonical source identities and project confinement remain intact.
assertions: Ignored unfinished draft text cannot abort preparation
Same-line content after endinput is still processed
Uses the supplied entry directory for lookup before resolving the main symlink
Includes extra.tex from inside inherited alltt state
Does not reuse an ordinary-comment cached scan inside alltt
Changing extra.tex changes source inventory hashes and invalidates the whole-paper comparison
Retains canonical source locators and refuses inputs outside the project boundary
